ārtavakṣayaḥ आर्तवक्षयः
Diminution of menstrual flow; or scanty menstruation
A disorder characterized by irregular menstruation/ metrorrhagia; scanty menstrual flow; pain in vagina.

.25 ārtavajananam आर्तवजननम्
Substance restoring menstrual flow

ITA-2.5.18 ārtavavaha-srotaḥ आर्तववहस्रोतः
Female reproductive system
All channels which are physiologically important in the regulation of the menstrual cycle.

ITA-5.5.12 ārtavavahasrotoduṣṭiḥ आर्तववहस्रोतोदुष्टिः
Vitiation of channels carrying menstrual flow
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: excessive or decreased or irregular menstrual flow, uterine prolapse, abortion, infertility.

ārtavavṛddhiḥ आर्तववृद्धिः
Morbid increase of menstrual flow
A disorder characterized by generalized body aches, excessive menstrual bleeding/menorrhagia, bad odour of menses.

ārtavavaiṣamyam आर्तववैषम्यम्
Disorders of menstrual flow
Changes in the quantity and quality of menstruation.

ITA-9.1.37 ārtasyaroganut आर्तस्यरोगनुत्
Curative medicine
A medicine which alleviates a patient’s ailments.

ITA-5.73.33 ārtavavahasrotoviddhaḥ आर्त्तववहस्रोतोविद्धः
Injury to the channels of the menstrual system
A disorder characterized by sterility; dyspareunia; absence of menstruation.
